source.note: One page per service: 2 Layer Prototype (1 oz) and 4 Layer Prototype (1 oz outer, 1/2 oz inner). Figures depend on the layer count.

min_hole_to_hole.quote: Overlapping drills | Allowed, but not guaranteed. May result in missing or slotted holes. 5 mil (0.127mm) clearance is recommended between holes.
min_hole_to_hole.note: A recommendation, given under overlapping drills.

min_silk_width.quote: Silkscreen minimum line width | 5 mil (0.127mm) (recommended minimum) 3 mil (0.0762mm) (short lines, text, graphics)
min_silk_width.note: 3 mil for text; 5 mil is recommended for lines.

min_silk_height.unpublished: OSH Park gives a line width for silkscreen, no text height.
